name: NaturalReader
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For NaturalReader, read user-provided text and documents aloud with a small set of licensed or local voices. The hard boundary is voice catalog, ocr, document formats, mobile apps, and commercial licensing options, plus models, compute, rights, and safety operations.
